name: Escape From the doctor
steps: ap fire extinguisher → doctor gets pushed back and stunned.
Tap surgical lamp → light swings and blocks his view.
Tap green flask → spills and makes him retreat.
Tap biohazard bag → covers and restricts movement.
Tap waste bin → drops down to trap his position.
Tap skeleton hand → distracts him briefly.
Tap forceps/tools → syringe gets redirected away.
Tap defibrillator pads → shocks system and disables him.
Tap laser device → final flash forces him out of the room, clearing the stage.
